images.description: Abstract pale surface with dark swirling patterns
images.photographer_description: Each of these swirling clouds is a result of a meteorological phenomenon known as a Karman vortex. These vortices appeared over Alexander Selkirk Island in the southern Pacific Ocean. Rising precipitously from the surrounding waters, the island's highest point is nearly a mile (1.6 km) above sea level. As wind-driven clouds encounter this obstacle, they flow around it to form these large, spinning eddies.

images.description: lava dripping to ocean
images.photographer_description: I was visiting the Big Island of Hawaii with some friends and family, and my brother convinced the group to take a lava tour by boat. I always kind of balk a little bit at overtly touristy stuff like that, but I think everyone was a pretty shocked when we got our first look at the Kalapana Lava Flow after about a half hour boat trip down the coast.  It’s such an awesome, phantasmagorical sight and, since they actually get surprisingly close to the spots where the rivers of lava meet the ocean and throw up sulfurous steam clouds, also a pretty visceral sensory experience.

But this time my diveguide found one at 25 meters dept while diving in the Philipinnes. Our divecomputer told us that we had 9 minutes to take the picture. The first minutes this seahorse was moving all the times and could not focus on him. Then he curled his tiny tail around the coral and i made some shots. With 1 minute to go we went up and finally i had my picture.

images.photographer_description: A painting of a cosy stone cottage by Sian Butler (my Mum). Sian is well known for her Australian Outback pastel paintings (number one, two, three etc., on Australian Google image search), but she is a also very versatile artist and has done a series of acrylic paintings of cottages. They are mostly inspired by cottages in Tasmania, but with an obvious British influence. In her cottage series, I like the way Sian has combined numerous textures and techniques to produce delightful scenes. She wants you to enjoy them and share them.

images.photographer_description: Lines and shapes etched into the surface of Antarctica's Robinson Glacier hint at the slow but inevitable movements of this giant river of ice. Patterns of lines may be icefalls, where a glacier cascades over rock, or a series of crevasses, massive cracks that form as different parts of a glacier move at slightly different speeds. Robinson Glacier flows down to the continent's coast, where glacial ice meets mammoth slabs of sea ice caught in the frigid embrace of the Southern Ocean.

images.photographer_description: I love taking hikes locally and hunting for mushrooms. It’s exciting to come across something new, document it, then research and identify them later. Sometimes, this leads to choice edibles. Sometimes, you learn that what you have found is best to be admired for its looks. The Amanita muscaria, commonly known as fly agaric, is a poisonous mushroom. Eating this mushroom can lead to nausea and stomach cramps at first, then eventually liver and kidney damage. If you ever have to ask if it is edible, do not eat it. Always consult an expert.

This photo is the result of making the best out of a bad situation, and a reminder of why I love camping.

images.photographer_description: I love taking hikes locally and hunting for mushrooms. It’s exciting to come across something new, document it, then research and identify them later. Sometimes, this leads to choice edibles. Sometimes, you learn that what you have found is best to be admired for its looks. The Amanita muscaria, commonly known as fly agaric, is a poisonous mushroom. Eating this mushroom can lead to nausea and stomach cramps at first, then eventually liver and kidney damage. If you ever have to ask if it is edible, do not eat it. Always consult an expert.

images.photographer_description: Near the Queen Fabiola Mountains, also called the Yamato Mountains, is a classic example of blue ice in Antarctica. Blue ice emerges where wind scours glaciers clean of snow and forms when air bubbles are squeezed out of layers of partially compacted snow left over from previous seasons. The ice appears blue because red and yellow wavelengths of light are absorbed. Deeply penetrating light is uniformly scattered at blue wavelengths by the enclosed air bubbles.

images.photographer_description: Truly a river of ice, Antarctica's relatively fast-moving Byrd Glacier courses through the Transantarctic Mountains at a rate of 0.8 kilometers (0.5 miles) per year. More than 180 kilometers (112 miles) long, the glacier flows down from the polar plateau (left) to the Ross Ice Shelf (right). Long, sweeping flow lines are crossed in places by much shorter lines, which are deep cracks in the ice called crevasses. The conspicuous red patches indicate areas of exposed rock.

That day I just made a casual walk in a small valley in Tatras to record a creek. When you hike in Tatras in valleys all you hear is the fast flow of the water crushing the stone.  As I stood to record some generic sounds of a creek an European dipper flow, stood on a rock on the middle of the creek and started its song. You can barely hear it but it's there, believe me.  No fade in or out so you can listen to the recording on continous loop.  Equipment: MixPre-6 mk1, MS setup Sennheiser MKH 30 & 50 Recordist: Maciej Wirmański, maciejwirmanski.pl

A high view follows a long dark beach below a brown sloping coastal bank. White wave lines advance and retreat along the curving shore, with scattered offshore rocks fading into misty grey sea.

A skier in a dark red jacket and yellow trousers approaches a snow ramp, launches high with skis turning in the air, and appears again in a closer airborne view. Tree-lined mountains and snow spray frame the action.
A red squirrel pauses on a horizontal branch amid dense green foliage, above a simple wooden railing.

A helmeted person stands on a pale blue board in rushing water beside large grey rocks, repeatedly shifting stance and pushing a paddle against the current. Foam surges around the board between samples.
A white modern streetcar approaches along embedded tracks across a sunlit city intersection. Passing cars cross the road before the vehicle reaches a large close front view.
A hand presses a metal tamper into coffee grounds in a portafilter. Later close-up views show espresso gathering beneath the polished filter and flowing in a dark stream.
Heavy dark clouds move over distant layered mountain ridges and a small strip of lake, framed by silhouetted trees. A bright opening changes shape and sends pale light toward the horizon.
A portrait view pans from a steep rocky ridge across a broad green-and-grey mountain basin, distant bare peaks and a bright blue sky. Foreground summit rocks appear at the bottom of later samples.
Bright white and violet fireworks open into layered arcs and sparkling trails against a deep navy sky.
Heavy rain veils a city street and buildings seen from above. Roadside tree crowns bend and change shape while cars pass below; the camera moves across the rain-softened view.
Soft blue-green waves roll toward the camera and break across a flat sandy shore beneath a pale clouded sky. Changing foam advances and drains over the wet foreground.
Several dark patterned fish swim among submerged stones in a shallow clear pool. Their positions and directions change visibly while a rough rock edge occupies the left foreground.
Low cloud and mist drift across layered wooded hills under a glowing break in an evening sky. Cloud shapes and light change visibly between samples while the landscape stays steady.
A portrait camera pans from a rocky curving shoreline toward a sandy beach and clear blue sea. Low waves break in bands; a small person is visible in the shallows near the later samples.
A narrow snowy trail leads between slender dark tree trunks, including a bowed branch arching over the path. The viewpoint advances and shifts toward sunlight entering through the trees.
A narrow waterfall descends a steep dark cliff onto shoreline rocks, with the sea and a bright blue sky to the left. Water and surf change between samples as the view shifts slightly closer.
Two bright streams fall from mossy dark rock into a small blue-green pool, with trees and twigs at the sides. Falling sheets and splash patterns change continuously in a stable wide view.
Fast dark water and pale foam rush around rocks between broad white snow shelves. Dense conifers line the opposite bank under a clear blue sky with soft clouds, while the rapids continually change.
Broad whitewater surges around dark rocks between densely green banks. Foam and eddies change rapidly across the samples while the camera holds a low upstream view.

A portrait view tilts upward along a pale blue-green river churning through steep narrow rock walls, then reveals orange-and-green trees and a rounded wooded mountain beyond. Foam patterns change around large boulders below.
Several skiers descend a bright snowy slope under suspended lift cabins. Snow sprays behind their turns while the sun casts strong lift shadows across the textured slope.

A wide view pans from decorated red columns and gilded arches across a rich theatre interior toward the stage and a seated audience. Warm lamps and a hanging ornament illuminate the ceiling and ornamentation.
A small striped squirrel moves over loose pale stones, pauses upright and shifts behind larger rocks. A fallen branch and softly focused green woodland sit behind it.
A small monkey sits and reaches among crossing branches and hanging vines within dense green foliage, then changes position and climbs down from its perch.
A small elephant walks close past the camera, turns away and circles back across a shaded concrete floor. Its trunk swings as it moves, with railings and people’s legs visible along the far edge.
A giraffe walks across pale tall grass in front of scattered leafy trees. Its body and neck shift across the frame as the camera follows, with some lower legs hidden by vegetation.
An overhead view follows many dolphins swimming close together through clear turquoise water. Their spacing changes as backs break the surface and leave fine wakes and splashes.

A seal rests on a pale uneven ice slab beside blue water scattered with smaller ice fragments. It raises and turns its head, then settles lower while the surrounding water and ice patterns shift subtly.
A seal lies on a sandy bank beside a narrow strip of shallow water, lifting and changing the angle of its head across the samples. Soft distant sand and water keep attention on the animal.
A small dark bird with warm-colored head markings turns and splashes in a shallow rocky pool. Water sprays and ripples change around it against a soft green woodland background.

A small black-and-white bird perches on a pale squared post, repeatedly bending to peck at the top and then lifting its head. A soft warm-colored background isolates the bird and its fine feather markings.
A gull stands on a rough stone wall above tiled roofs and hillside buildings under a softly colored evening sky. The camera moves closer and follows the bird as it turns and changes position.

A green-and-orange open-sided sightseeing vehicle passes close to the camera, carrying seated visitors and pulling additional passenger cars. Palm trees and bright blue sky surround the sunlit street.

A portrait view tilts from an arched spout and nearby building windows down over a basin densely covered in yellow, pink, red and white roses. People stand beyond the basin as the flowers fill the later frames.
An elevated panorama moves across dense buildings, illuminated windows and a tall slender observation tower under a lavender-blue sky. Warm light catches a few distant towers as the view turns.
A moving view passes shoppers and tightly packed tables of colorful clothing and other goods beneath varied umbrellas. People cross the foreground as the camera pans through a sunlit market lane.

A portrait view pans through a busy market on reddish ground, with shoppers passing close to the camera and produce, sacks and baskets displayed along the lane. Low market shelters and a taller unfinished-looking building stand beyond.

Two vendors handle and cut large pieces of browned roasted meat on round wooden blocks, with a roast pig head visible on the counter. Customers, trays and market lamps fill the shaded stall behind them.

Fast rippling water runs beneath a steel truss bridge, with a gravel bank, bare branches and bright moss-covered rocks in the foreground. Changing foam patterns supply motion within a largely consistent composition.

A person tends a soot-darkened rounded stone oven in a sunlit courtyard, reaching into its opening and using a long tool as pale smoke rises. Stone walls, shrubs and light hills surround the workspace.

A worker sits in a compact bakery workspace among bowls, dough rounds and a large stack of pale cooked flatbreads. He leans forward, handles round bread or dough pieces and reaches into the work area while another person sits behind.
Clear shallow water flows around rounded stones through a green forest corridor. Later samples move across the rocky channel, bringing flowing water and boulders closer into view.

Browned food pieces and larger tied parcels cook on a metal grate above orange flames and glowing wood coals. A person works near the grill as the camera moves closer to the sizzling-looking surface and drifting smoke.

Small dinghies with white sails line a sunny waterside ramp and beach while people walk and prepare boats. Calm water, green banks and distant houses form a wide setting as sailors and boats change position.
A low wooden sailboat with a tall pale sail moves from the right edge toward the centre across rippled blue-green water. People sit aboard and distant sails stand along the flat horizon.
A tall dark sailboat moves across silver sunlit water, with several smaller sail silhouettes along the distant horizon. Its position shifts as the camera follows and the reflected light ripples.

A small red propeller aircraft approaches along a snow-covered runway, passes near the camera and lifts into the air against forested slopes and distant snow-covered mountains. The camera pans to follow its departure.
A high view drifts over brown fields, scattered green trees and many small pointed structures beneath a low golden sun. The foreground shifts below the camera while the hazy horizon remains distant.
A large orange balloon brightens from within, turns dark and glows again against a blue-to-orange twilight sky. A crowd of silhouettes below raises phones toward it.
Low warm sunlight glows above a snowy open landscape as thin streams of windblown snow sweep over the ground. A bundled figure sits or crouches in the scene, with distant layered hills beyond.
A large yellow sun sits partly below the dark sea horizon against a deep red sky. Gentle surface texture and small shifts in the sun and framing are visible across the samples.
An airplane wing extends across a deep blue sky above a broad blanket of sunlit clouds. The viewpoint shifts slightly and warm horizon light spreads across the cloud surface.
A broad rainbow crosses pink-grey clouds above tall riverside grass and a long pale truss bridge. The camera pans across the arc and bridge as the sunlit structures catch warm light.
A vivid rainbow curves across a dark cloud bank above open dry fields and distant hills. The camera pans across the arc beside a road, with passing cars and a streetlamp entering the composition.
A branching spiky-leaved tree fills the left side beneath a densely starred night sky. Star positions and occasional brief light streaks change between samples while the tree stays fixed.

Tall palm trees stand above low shrubs and a distant ridge beneath a wide densely starred blue night sky. Faint sky patterns and points shift across the samples while the softly lit foreground stays fixed.
Purple, red and gold fan-shaped bursts flare low above dark water and distant shoreline lights. Spectators stand behind a railing in the foreground as the bursts bloom, fade and change color.
Gray-blue surf breaks around a cluster of dark coastal rocks, including a low natural arch. Green grass and fence posts fill the foreground, with low cloudy cliffs behind.
A kayaker in a red kayak and bright yellow helmet paddles through turbulent whitewater between dark rocks. The boat tilts and turns as it passes through the churning wave.
Several surfers paddle and ride a clean green-blue wave as it breaks into white foam along the rocky coast.
Kayakers in bright boats maneuver through churning whitewater between dark rocky banks.
Foaming water rushes through dark, shallow rapids beneath a shaded bank of dense green foliage. A few thin branches cross the foreground, while a bright yellow-green leaf hangs at the upper right.
Two yellow rafts with passengers move through churning white rapids, framed by dark green trees and large shoreline rocks. The rafts shift through the turbulent water across the samples.
Skiers carve down a broad resort slope beneath chairlifts and a low, cloudy winter sky.
A sweeping view across jagged high mountain ridges, with a rocky summit in the foreground and snow tracing distant slopes.
A red fox moves along the edge of a snow covered yard, its orange coat standing out against pale snow and dark winter woods.
A small fox sits alert on a low earthen bank, framed by leafy green branches and dark tree trunks. Across the samples it turns its head and shifts its gaze while staying in nearly the same spot.
Two brown-gray monkeys sit together in a green clearing, one carefully grooming the other.
A giraffe stretches its long neck into a small tree amid dry scrub, with muted clouds above the open landscape.
A small boat moves along a calm canal bordered by stone embankments, leafy trees, and city buildings.
A broad stone bridge spans the Vltava beneath a bright blue sky, with small boats moving through the water and spring trees along the banks.
Tall buildings form a dark silhouette along the water’s edge. Above them, scattered clouds shift through muted pink, lavender, and blue tones as evening deepens.
Aerial views trace the long bridge across blue water toward a sandy shoreline and green riverbank; the raised draw span and branching wakes give the calm scene a clear focal point.
Visitors gather around a low stone oven in a sunlit village courtyard, beside rough masonry walls, a small tree, and a rustic roofline.
People gather around a bright open fire in darkness, followed by close views of hands working dough and a person preparing it beside the fire.
